stem:
Hitesh compares two samples.
Sample X: shiny, can be hammered into a thin sheet, rings when struck, and conducts electricity.
Sample Y: dull powder that breaks when hammered and does not conduct electricity.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Sample X shows properties typical of a metal.
Sample Y shows properties typical of a non-metal.
Sample Y must be a metal because it is a solid powder.
Sample X is a non-metal because only non-metals can be shiny.

teacher.key_rationale: Lustre, malleability, sonority, and conductivity point to a metal for X; dull, brittle, non-conducting Y fits a non-metal.
